name: Ballista
description: The ballista, plural ballistae or ballistas, sometimes called bolt thrower, was an ancient projectile weapon that launched either bolts or stones at a distant target.

gallery.caption: Battle at the Harzhorn: Iron tips of Roman catapult projectiles.

Example of a four-wheeled ballista.
Print shows two soldiers with a horse-drawn ballista. The device, mounted on a wagon, is manipulated like a crossbow, shooting large arrows at enemy fortifications. The horses are well covered with armor. Taken from the collection Notitia utraque cum orientis tum
IV A.D. Balista exposed in Cluj History Museum. Balista was found at Dierna castra in the Romanian city of Orșova in Mehedinți County.
